title: seek server configuration
description: The server configuration, read by `seek serve`: `/etc/seek/server.yml`. `--config <path>` or `SEEK_CONFIG` names another file in its place. Each field also has an environment variable and a flag, derived from its path as the configuration specification describes.

server.description: Where the server listens and how it authenticates clients.

host.description: Interface the server binds. The server image sets `SEEK_SERVER_HOST=0.0.0.0`.

require-token.description: Whether a request must carry one of `server.tokens`. Set it to false only on a trusted network; the server then logs a warning at startup.

tokens.description: The client tokens the server accepts, as one comma-separated value, so that a new token can be added before the old one is removed. Required while `server.require-token` is true.

secret-refresh-seconds.description: How long the server uses each secret it resolved before it resolves it again. A later resolution that fails keeps the value already held. Zero resolves on every use.
